entry_evidence.raw_source_text: System 1 Entry: Turtles entered positions when the price exceeded by a single tick the high or low of the preceding 20 days. If the price exceeded the 20-day high, the Turtles would buy one Unit to initiate a long position. System 1 breakout entry signals were ignored if the last breakout would have resulted in a winning trade.
entry_evidence.captured_entry_rule: Long entry when price exceeds by one tick the preceding 20-day high; initiate with one Unit. S1 signal is ignored when the last breakout would have resulted in a winning trade.

conditions.long: price exceeds preceding 20-day high by one tick
conditions.prior_breakout_condition: take S1 signal only when the last breakout would have been a losing breakout
